title: Recognizing the classical part
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and let $
u_X^*\dashv
u_{X,*}$ be the comparison adjunction from the small étale site to the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The functor
$
u_X^*\colon\Sh(X_{\Et})	o\Sh(X_{\Proet})$ on sheaves of sets is fully faithful. Its essential image is exactly the classical sheaves of [sk-def-pe-classical-definition].

Let $\Lambda$ be a discrete commutative ring, let $\Lambda_{X,\Et}$ be its constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and write $\Lambda_X=
u_X^*\Lambda_{X,\Et}$. For module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the same inverse image is an exact equivalence between $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and the full subcategory of classical $\Lambda_X$-module sheaves on $X_{\Proet}$, where classicality is as in [sk-def-pe-classical-definition].

proof.text: Apply [det-pe-classical-sheaves-unit] at X. Its Hom-set bijectivity is exactly the criterion Functor.FullyFaithful.nonempty_iff_map_bijective, giving the first clause.

source.place: First sentence, unit and full faithfulness; detailed sk-thm-pe-classical-sheaves-unit.proof.md, both paragraphs; Stacks Tag 099T, proetale.tex lemma-fully-faithful.

proof.text: Apply the first equivalence of [det-pe-classical-sheaves-image]. Functor.essImage uses an isomorphism from the inverse image to G, whereas the cited theorem uses the reverse isomorphism; taking inverses identifies the two existential statements. The predicates are the continuity-map definitions of [sk-def-pe-classical-definition] and [det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map].

source.place: First sentence after full faithfulness and the converse/counit paragraph; detailed sk-thm-pe-classical-sheaves-image.proof.md, implications (1) to (2), (2) to (3), (3) to (1); Bhatt–Scholze Lemmas 5.1.1–5.1.2 and Definition 5.1.3, p. 34.

proof.text: Apply [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules] for the arbitrary discrete commutative ring Λ. Identify its underlying-set classicality predicate with IsClassicalModuleFor of [sk-def-pe-classical-definition]: the forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits and reflects isomorphisms, and preservesColimitIso_inv_comp_desc identifies the two restriction-induced continuity maps of [det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map]. The module theorem now identifies classical modules with the essential image of comparisonUpperStar and gives bijectivity on Hom sets. Lift comparisonUpperStar into the full subcategory of classical modules using ObjectProperty.lift. The lift is fully faithful because comparisonUpperStar is. Every classical module is isomorphic to an image object, and ObjectProperty.isoMk lifts this isomorphism to the full subcategory, proving essential surjectivity. Hence the lift is an equivalence. Equivalences preserve all existing limits and colimits, in particular finite ones. The lift composed with the inclusion is definitionally comparisonUpperStar. No finiteness assumption on Λ or finite-coefficient theorem is needed.

source.place: Last sentence; detailed sk-thm-pe-classical-sheaves-modules.proof.md, all four paragraphs (module structures, exactness, full faithfulness, essential image). The arbitrary-coefficient module theorem suffices; the finite-coefficient specialization is pruned.

proof_origin.place: The three clauses of the unit proof; J2 Lean implementation from the existing unit, essential-image, and arbitrary-coefficient module theorems. The full-subcategory equivalence and finite-limit/colimit preservation are generic categorical consequences.
